verdict.rationale: Visa Intelligent Commerce supplies payment credentials, passkey-authenticated instructions and spend mandates that a developer's agent uses. That makes it a building block for agent-initiated purchases. The evidence shows no product-owned automation that a user sets up to run autonomously or on a recurring schedule in the background. Each Payment Instruction is a one-off action the user authenticates with a passkey, and 'trigger post-purchase actions' is a related but different capability, not background automation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
